_comment: Compiler caches of the offload build hosts (#307, docs/worker-offload.md#compiler-cache). The remote build scripts install the pinned release per build user under the host's work directory (no admin, no sudo), check its SHA-256 and pass it as CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER; a host that cannot fetch or verify it builds without a cache. The cache itself lives in the work directory too.
